{{nihongo|'''Tenchi Shrine'''|天地神社}} is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} located in the Hirai area of {{ill|Kannami|Q1203533|qid=Q1203533}}, {{ill|Tagata District, Shizuoka|fr|District de Tagata|id|Distrik Tagata, Shizuoka|it|Distretto di Tagata|ja|田方郡|ko|다가타군|pl|Powiat Tagata|uk|Повіт Таґата|zh|田方郡|qid=Q1154841}}, {{ill|Shizuoka Prefecture|Q131320|qid=Q131320}}.<ref name="yuisho">[http://www.shizuoka-jinjacho.or.jp/shokai/jinja.php?id=4402078 Tenchi Shrine] - Shizuoka Prefecture Association of Shinto Shrines</ref> {{nihongo|'''Tenchi Shrine'''|天地神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Izu Province]].

== Overview ==
The shrine is located in the northern part of the Hirai area, south of the point where {{ill|Shizuoka Prefectural Road Route 135|Q11663291|qid=Q11663291|lt=Prefectural Route 135}}, descending from JR {{ill|Kannami Station|Q852321|qid=Q852321}}, merges with {{ill|Shizuoka Prefectural Road Route 11|Q11663278|qid=Q11663278|lt=Prefectural Route 11 (Netsukan Road)}}.

It is considered a candidate shrine (ronsha) of '''Ametsuseketachi no Mikoto Shrine''' (阿米都瀬気多知命神社), which is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}}.<ref>[https://yaokami.jp/1222875/ Tenchi Shrine] - Yaoyorozu no Kami</ref>
